en.s: The Battle of Baisi (simplified Chinese: 柏肆之战; traditional Chinese: 柏肆之戰; pinyin: Bǎisì zhī zhàn) was fought in late March 397 during the Northern Wei invasion of Later Yan during the Sixteen Kingdoms period of China. The battle concluded in victory for Wei and was a turning point in their campaign, as a large portion of the main Yan forces was destroyed, causing rebellions to spring up against the Yan.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 柏肆之战发生于397年3月下旬，是十六国时期北魏入侵后燕期间的一场战斗。魏军获胜，这场胜利成为战役的转折点：后燕主力大部被歼，随后各地爆发叛乱。
zh.n: 本条记录采用原文资料框列出的事件结束日期。

en.t: King Richard I of England is wounded by a crossbow bolt while fighting in France, leading to his death on April 6
en.s: Richard I (8 September 1157 – 6 April 1199), known as Richard the Lionheart or Richard Cœur de Lion (Old Norman French: Quor de Lion) because of his reputation as a great military leader and warrior, was King of England from 1189 until his death in 1199. He also ruled as Duke of Normandy, Aquitaine, and Gascony; Lord of Cyprus; Count of Poitiers, Anjou, Maine, and Nantes; and was overlord of Brittany at various times during the same period.

zh.t: 英格兰国王理查一世在法国作战时被弩箭射伤，后于4月6日去世
zh.s: 理查一世（1157年9月8日—1199年4月6日）因其杰出的军事领导能力和战士声望，被称为“狮心王理查”或“狮心理查”（古诺曼法语：Quor de Lion）。他自1189年起担任英格兰国王，直至1199年去世。同一时期，他还统治诺曼底、阿基坦和加斯科涅，兼任塞浦路斯领主、普瓦捷伯爵、安茹伯爵、曼恩伯爵和南特伯爵，并曾在不同时期作为布列塔尼的宗主。

en.s: The siege of Varna (Bulgarian: Обсада на Варна) took place between 21 and 24 March 1201 at Varna, on the Bulgarian Black Sea coast between the Bulgarians and the Byzantines. The Bulgarians were victorious and captured the city.

zh.s: 1201年3月21日至24日，保加利亚与拜占庭军队在保加利亚黑海沿岸的瓦尔纳交战。保加利亚军队获胜，攻占该城。

en.s: Battle of Halych (1221) was an armed clash as part of the Galician War of Succession, which took place between a coalition of Ruthenian princes supported by the Polovtsians and Hungarian-Polish forces led by the voivode File.

zh.s: 1221年3月24日，罗斯诸侯与波洛韦茨人结成的联军，在加利西亚继承战争中的哈利奇战役中击败由总督菲莱率领的匈牙利、波兰军队。姆斯季斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇率领罗斯联军作战，起初波军进攻迫使一支罗斯部队后退，后来波洛韦茨人反击，联军扭转战局，菲莱被俘。

en.s: The Battle of Margate (), also known as the Battle of Cadzand (not to be confused with the 1337 Battle of Cadzand), was a naval battle that took place on 24–25 March 1387, during the Caroline War phase of the Hundred Years' War, between an English fleet and a Franco-Castilian-Flemish wine fleet. The battle ended in an English victory: many ships were captured, and a vast haul of booty was acquired, including 8,000–9,000 tuns of wine.

zh.s: 马盖特海战又称卡赞德海战，应与1337年的同名战役区分。1387年3月24日至25日，百年战争卡罗琳战争阶段，英国舰队与法国、卡斯蒂利亚和佛兰德的葡萄酒运输船队交战。英国获胜，俘获许多船只和大量战利品，包括8,000至9,000大桶葡萄酒。

en.s: The Turco-Mongol or Turko-Mongol tradition was an ethnocultural synthesis that arose in Asia during the 13-14th century among the ruling elites of the Golden Horde and the Chagatai Khanate. The ruling Mongol elites of these khanates eventually assimilated into the Turkic populations that they conquered and ruled over, thus becoming known as Turco-Mongols. These elites gradually adopted Islam, as well as Turkic languages, while retaining Mongol political and legal institutions.

zh.t: 突厥—蒙古皇帝帖木儿洗劫大马士革
zh.s: 突厥—蒙古传统是一种在13至14世纪亚洲兴起的族群文化融合，主要形成于金帐汗国和察合台汗国的统治精英之中。这些汗国的蒙古统治者逐渐融入其征服和统治的突厥族群，因此被称为突厥—蒙古人。这些精英逐步接受伊斯兰教和突厥语，同时保留蒙古的政治与法律制度。

en.t: James VI of Scotland is proclaimed King James I of England and Ireland, upon the death of Elizabeth I
en.s: James VI and I (James Charles Stuart; 19 June 1566 – 27 March 1625) was King of Scotland as James VI from 24 July 1567, and King of England and Ireland as James I from the union of the Scottish and English crowns on 24 March 1603, until his death in 1625.

zh.t: 詹姆斯六世继位为英格兰和爱尔兰国王
zh.s: 詹姆斯六世和一世（詹姆斯·查尔斯·斯图亚特）于1567年7月24日起担任苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世，并于1603年3月24日苏格兰与英格兰王位合并后成为英格兰和爱尔兰国王詹姆斯一世，直至1625年去世。

en.t: Tokugawa Ieyasu is granted the title of shōgun from Emperor Go-Yōzei, and establishes the Tokugawa shogunate in Edo, Japan
en.s: Tokugawa Ieyasu (born Matsudaira Takechiyo; January 31, 1543 – June 1, 1616) was a Japanese samurai, daimyo and the founder and first shogun of the Tokugawa shogunate of Japan, which ruled from 1603 until the Meiji Restoration in 1868. He was the third of the three "Great Unifiers" of Japan, along with his former lord Oda Nobunaga and fellow Oda subordinate Toyotomi Hideyoshi.

zh.t: 德川家康获任征夷大将军
zh.s: 1603年3月24日，德川家康开始出任征夷大将军。他是日本武士、大名，也是德川幕府的创建者和首任将军；幕府统治持续到1868年明治维新。在日本统一史上的“三杰”中，他排在曾为其主君的织田信长和丰臣秀吉之后。

en.s: The Battle of Boldon Hill was a day-long engagement that took place in modern-day Tyne and Wear between English Royalists and an army made up of Scottish Covenanters in alliance with Parliamentarians from nearby Sunderland on 24 March 1644 during the First English Civil War.

zh.s: 第一次英国内战期间，英格兰保王党军队与苏格兰圣约派军队及附近桑德兰的议会派部队，于1644年3月24日在今泰恩-威尔郡进行了一整天的战斗。

en.s: The Battle of Darsūniškis took place on March 24, 1702, near the town of Darsūniškis (Polish: Dorsuniszki) during the Swedish invasion of Poland in the Great Northern War. The Swedish army of about 240 men under the command of Alexander Hummerhielm was defeated by the Polish–Lithuanian army of 6,000 men under Michał Serwacy Wiśniowiecki.

zh.s: 1702年3月24日，瑞典入侵波兰期间，瑞典军队在达尔苏尼什基镇附近遭遇波兰—立陶宛军队。亚历山大·胡默希尔姆指挥约240名瑞典士兵，被米哈乌·谢尔瓦齐·维希尼奥维茨基指挥的6000名波兰—立陶宛士兵击败。

en.t: Count Frederick of Hesse-Kassel is elected King of Sweden by the Riksdag of the Estates, after his consort Ulrika Eleonora abdicated the throne on 29 February
en.s: Frederick I (Swedish: Fredrik I; 28 April 1676 – 5 April 1751) was King of Sweden from 1720 until his death, having been prince consort of Sweden from 1718 to 1720, and was also Landgrave of Hesse-Kassel from 1730. He ascended the throne following the death of his brother-in-law absolutist Charles XII in the Great Northern War, and the abdication of his wife, Charles's sister and successor Ulrika Eleonora, after she had to relinquish most powers to the Riksdag of the Estates and thus chose to abdicate.

zh.t: 腓特烈一世成为瑞典国王
zh.s: 1720年3月24日，腓特烈一世继任瑞典国王，在位至1751年去世；此前他从1718年至1720年是瑞典王夫，1730年起还兼任黑森－卡塞尔伯爵。大北方战争中，绝对君主查理十二世去世，其妹及继位者乌尔丽卡·埃莉诺拉将大部分权力让给等级议会后选择退位，腓特烈因而登基。

en.s: The Siege of Kandahar (Persian: محاصرهٔ قندهار) began when Nader Shah's Afsharid army invaded southern Afghanistan to topple the last Hotaki stronghold of Loy Kandahar, which was held by Hussain Hotaki. It took place in the Old Kandahar area of the modern city of Kandahar in Afghanistan and lasted until March 24, 1738, when the Hotaki Afghans were defeated by the Persian army, namely the Afsharid empire.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 纳迪尔沙的阿夫沙尔军队入侵阿富汗南部，试图推翻侯赛因·霍塔基控制的霍塔基王朝最后一个据点老坎大哈，由此开始坎大哈围城战。战场位于今阿富汗坎大哈市的老城区。围城战持续至1738年3月24日，霍塔基军队被波斯阿夫沙尔王朝军队击败。

en.s: The Battle of Martinique was a successful British invasion of the French colony of Martinique in the West Indies during the French Revolutionary Wars. They continued to occupy the island until 1802, when the Treaty of Amiens restored it to French control.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 马提尼克战役是法国大革命战争期间英国成功入侵西印度群岛法国殖民地马提尼克的一场军事行动。英国一直占领该岛，直到1802年《亚眠条约》将其归还法国。

en.t: In Kraków, Tadeusz Kościuszko announces a general uprising against Imperial Russia and the Kingdom of Prussia, and assumes the powers of the Commander in Chief of all of the Polish forces
en.s: Andrzej Tadeusz Bonawentura Kościuszko (English: Andrew Thaddeus Bonaventure Kosciuszko; February 4 or 12, 1746 – October 15, 1817) was a Polish military engineer, statesman, and military leader who became a national hero in Poland, the United States, Lithuania, and Belarus. He fought in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth's struggles against Russia and Prussia, and on the U.S. side in the American Revolutionary War.

zh.t: 塔德乌什·柯斯丘什科在克拉科夫宣布起义，反抗俄罗斯帝国和普鲁士王国，并接掌波兰全部武装力量的最高指挥权
zh.s: 安杰伊·塔德乌什·博纳文图拉·柯斯丘什科（英语名：Andrew Thaddeus Bonaventure Kosciuszko；1746年2月4日或12日—1817年10月15日）是波兰军事工程师、政治家和军事领袖，在波兰、美国、立陶宛和白俄罗斯被奉为民族英雄。他参与波兰立陶宛联邦对抗俄罗斯和普鲁士的战争，也在美国独立战争中站在美国一方作战。

en.s: The Battle of Crête-à-Pierrot was a major battle of the Saint-Domingue expedition that took place between 2 March and 24 March 1802 as part of the expedition's efforts to retake the colony of Saint-Domingue from Toussaint Louverture's control. The battle took place at the Crête-à-Pierrot fort ("Little Peter's Crest;" in Haitian Creole Lakrèt-a-Pyewo), east of Saint-Marc on the valley of the Artibonite River.

zh.s: 圣多明各远征期间，1802年3月2日至24日发生克雷特-阿皮耶罗战役，这是远征军试图从杜桑·卢维杜尔手中夺回圣多明各殖民地的一部分。战斗发生在克雷特-阿皮耶罗堡，位于圣马克以东、阿蒂博尼特河谷内。堡名意为“小彼得山脊”，海地克里奥尔语称Lakrèt-a-Pyewo。

en.s: The Battle of Los Yébenes (24 March 1809) was a conflict between the Regiment of Polish Lancers (Legion of the Vistula) and multiple regiments of Spanish cavalry, near the Spanish village of Los Yébenes (today, a municipality). The heavily outnumbered Polish regiment, led by Colonel Jan Konopka, was surprised and nearly defeated by the larger Spanish force.

zh.s: 洛斯耶贝内斯战役于1809年3月24日爆发，是波兰枪骑兵团（维斯瓦军团）与多支西班牙骑兵团之间的战斗，战场位于西班牙洛斯耶贝内斯村附近。由扬·科诺普卡上校率领的波兰军团兵力远少于对手，遭遇突袭，险些被击败。

en.s: The Parliament of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland is the supreme legislative body of the United Kingdom. It meets at the Palace of Westminster in London. It is bicameral, consisting of the House of Commons and the House of Lords, with the sovereign forming a third constitutional element. Acting together to legislate, these constitute the King-in-Parliament.
en.n: The Parliament of the United Kingdom passes the Roman Catholic Relief Act 1829, allowing Catholics to serve in Parliament.

zh.s: 大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国议会是英国的最高立法机构，在伦敦威斯敏斯特宫举行会议。议会实行两院制，由下议院和上议院组成，君主则构成第三个宪政要素。三者共同立法时，称为“国王会同议会”。
zh.n: 英国议会通过《1829年罗马天主教救济法案》，允许天主教徒担任议员。

en.s: The Battle of Hyderabad, also called The Battle of Dubba (or The Battle of Dubbo in contemporary references) was fought on 24 March 1843 between the British colonial empire and the Talpur Emirs of Sindh near Hyderabad, Sindh, Pakistan. A small British force, led by Captain James Outram, who were attacked by the Talpur Balochis and forced to make a fort of the British residency, which they successfully defended until they finally escaped to a waiting river steamer. After the British victory at Meeanee (also spelt Miani), Sir Charles Napier continued his advance to the Indus River and attacked the Sindh Capital of Hyderabad.

zh.s: 海得拉巴战役又称杜巴或杜博战役，于1843年3月24日在今巴基斯坦信德省海得拉巴附近发生，交战双方为英国殖民帝国与信德的塔尔普尔埃米尔。此前，詹姆斯·欧特拉姆上尉率领的一小股英军遭塔尔普尔俾路支部队进攻，被迫将英国驻扎官署改作堡垒坚守，最终成功撤至等候的河轮。英国在米亚尼战役获胜后，查尔斯·纳皮尔爵士继续向印度河推进，进攻信德首府海得拉巴。

en.s: The First Schleswig War (German: Schleswig-Holsteinischer Krieg), also known as the Schleswig-Holstein uprising (German: Schleswig-Holsteinische Erhebung) and the Three Years' War (Danish: Treårskrigen), was a military conflict in southern Denmark and northern Germany rooted in the Schleswig–Holstein question: who should control the duchies of Schleswig, Holstein and Lauenburg, which at the time were ruled by the king of Denmark in a personal union.

zh.t: 第一次石勒苏益格战争爆发
zh.s: 第一次石勒苏益格战争又称石勒苏益格－荷尔斯泰因起义或三年战争，是在丹麦南部和德国北部爆发的军事冲突。争端核心是当时由丹麦国王以共主邦联形式统治的石勒苏益格、荷尔斯泰因和劳恩堡三个公国应归谁控制。资料框将战争起点列为1848年3月24日。

en.t: President José Gregorio Monagas abolishes slavery in Venezuela
en.s: José Gregorio Monagas (4 May 1795 – 15 July 1858) was the president of Venezuela from 1851 to 1855, and brother of José Tadeo Monagas.

zh.t: 委内瑞拉总统何塞·格雷戈里奥·莫纳加斯废除奴隶制
zh.s: 何塞·格雷戈里奥·莫纳加斯（1795年5月4日—1858年7月15日）于1851年至1855年担任委内瑞拉总统，是何塞·塔德奥·莫纳加斯的兄弟。

en.t: Sakuradamon Incident: Japanese chief minister (Tairō) Ii Naosuke is assassinated by rōnin samurai outside the Sakurada Gate of Edo Castle
en.s: Ii Naosuke (井伊 直弼; November 29, 1814 – March 24, 1860) was a daimyō (feudal lord) of Hikone (1850–1860) and also Tairō of the Tokugawa shogunate, Japan, a position he held from April 23, 1858, until his assassination in the Sakuradamon Incident on March 24, 1860. He is most famous for signing the Harris Treaty with the United States, granting access to ports for trade to American merchants and seamen and extraterritoriality to American citizens.

zh.t: 樱田门外之变：井伊直弼遇刺
zh.s: 1860年3月24日，彦根藩主、德川幕府大老井伊直弼在樱田门外之变中遭暗杀。他自1858年4月23日起担任大老，尤其以签署《日美修好通商条约》闻名；该条约向美国商人和船员开放日本港口，并给予美国公民治外法权。

en.s: The Skirmish of the Brick Church was the first land engagement in Northeast Florida between the Union Army and Confederate Army of the American Civil War. It was fought on March 24, 1862 and resulted in the first Confederate victory in Florida.

zh.s: 1862年3月24日，美国南北双方军队在佛罗里达东北部首次发生陆上交战，史称砖教堂小规模战斗。此战也成为南军在佛罗里达取得的首次胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Paso del Muerto (Spanish: Batalla del Paso del Muerto), also known as the Action of Paso del Muerto or the Combat of Paso del Muerto, was a skirmish during the Dominican Restoration War that took place on March 24, 1864, between Spanish forces under the command of Brigadier Juan Suero and Dominican forces commanded by General Gregorio Luperón. The engagement ended in a Spanish victory.

zh.s: 死人渡口战役于1864年3月24日多米尼加复国战争期间发生，是胡安·苏埃罗准将率领的西班牙军队，与格雷戈里奥·卢佩龙将军指挥的多米尼加军队之间的一场小规模战斗，最终西班牙军队获胜。

en.t: The last of Tītokowaru's forces surrender to the New Zealand government, ending his uprising
en.s: The Colony of New Zealand was a colony of the United Kingdom from 1841 to 1907. British authority was vested in a governor. The colony had three successive capitals: Okiato (or Old Russell) in 1841; Auckland from 1841 to 1865; and Wellington from 1865. Following the New Zealand Constitution Act 1852, the colony became a Crown colony with its first elected parliament in 1853.

zh.t: 蒂托科瓦鲁的最后一批部队向新西兰政府投降，他的起义由此结束
zh.s: 新西兰殖民地于1841年至1907年间是英国殖民地，由总督代表英国行使权力。殖民地先后三次迁都：1841年为奥基亚托（或称旧罗素），1841年至1865年为奥克兰，1865年起为惠灵顿。根据1852年《新西兰宪法法案》，该殖民地成为王室殖民地，并于1853年举行首次议会选举。

en.s: The 1877 FA Cup final was a football match between Wanderers and Oxford University on 24 March 1877 at Kennington Oval in London. It was the sixth final of the world's oldest football competition, the Football Association Challenge Cup (known in the modern era as the FA Cup). Wanderers were the reigning cup-holders and had won the competition three times in total.

zh.s: 1877年3月24日，流浪者队与牛津大学队在伦敦肯宁顿椭圆球场进行足总杯决赛。这是世界上历史最悠久的足球赛事——英格兰足球总会挑战杯、即今天足总杯——的第6届决赛。流浪者为卫冕冠军，此前已三次夺冠。

en.t: The day he announced the discovery of the tuberculosis bacterium, 24 March 1882, has been observed by the World Health Organization as "World Tuberculosis Day" every year since 1982
en.s: Heinrich Hermann Robert Koch ( KOKH; German: [ˈʁoːbɛʁt kɔx] ; 11 December 1843 – 27 May 1910) was a German physician and microbiologist. He won the 1905 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine "for his investigations and discoveries in relation to tuberculosis". As the discoverer of the specific causative agents of deadly infectious diseases, including tuberculosis, cholera, and anthrax, he is regarded as one of the main founders of modern bacteriology.

zh.s: 1882年3月24日，德国医生、微生物学家罗伯特·科赫公布了结核病病原菌的发现；世界卫生组织后来将这一天定为世界防治结核病日。他还发现霍乱与炭疽等致命传染病的病原体，是现代细菌学的主要奠基人之一，并因结核病研究获得1905年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。

en.s: The Battle of Bang Bo, known in China as the battle of Zhennan Pass (Chinese:鎮南關之役), was an important Chinese victory during the Sino-French War (August 1884–April 1885). The battle, fought on 23 and 24 March 1885 on the Tonkin-Guangxi border, saw the defeat of 1,500 soldiers of General François de Négrier's 2nd Brigade of the Tonkin Expeditionary Corps by a Chinese army under the command of the Guangxi military commissioner Pan Dingxin (潘鼎新). The battle set the scene for the French Retreat from Lang Son on 28 March and the conclusion of the Sino-French War in early April in circumstances of considerable embarrassment for France.

zh.s: 镇南关之战又称邦博战役，是中法战争（1884年8月至1885年4月）期间中国取得的一次重要胜利。1885年3月23日至24日，广西巡抚潘鼎新指挥的清军，在越北与广西边境，击败弗朗索瓦·德·尼格里将军所属北圻远征军第2旅的1,500名法军士兵。此战为法军3月28日从谅山撤退埋下伏笔，中法战争于4月初结束时，法国的处境也因此相当尴尬。

en.t: Carnegie Steel Company is formed in New Jersey; its capitalization of $160 million is the largest to date

The 23rd parliament of New South Wales was dissolved on 21 February 1917 by the governor, Sir Gerald Strickland, on the advice of the premier William Holman.

en.s: World War II, or the Second World War (1 September 1939 – 2 September 1945), was a global conflict between two coalitions: the Allies and the Axis powers. Nearly all of the world's countries participated, with many engaging in total war on an unprecedented scale. World War II was the deadliest conflict in history, causing the deaths of 60 to 75 million people, a majority of whom were civilians.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战（1939年9月1日—1945年9月2日）是同盟国与轴心国两大阵营之间的全球性冲突。世界上几乎所有国家都参与其中，许多国家投入了前所未有规模的总体战。第二次世界大战是历史上死亡人数最多的冲突，造成6,000万至7,500万人死亡，其中大多数是平民。

en.s: Operation Varsity (24 March 1945) was a successful airborne forces operation launched by Allied troops toward the end of World War II. Involving more than 16,000 paratroopers and several thousand aircraft, it is the largest airborne operation ever conducted on a single day and in one location. Varsity was part of Operation Plunder, the Anglo-American-Canadian effort, led by Field Marshal Bernard Montgomery, to cross the northern Rhine River and from there enter Northern Germany.

en.s: The 1976 Argentine coup d'état was a right-wing coup that overthrew Isabel Perón as President of Argentina on 24 March 1976. A military junta was installed to replace her; this was headed by General Jorge Rafael Videla, Admiral Emilio Eduardo Massera and Brigadier-General Orlando Ramón Agosti. The junta took the official name of "National Reorganization Process", and remained in power until 10 December 1983. Although political repression was happening before the coup (Military disappearing people and killing), it was also heavily extended after the coup ended. The result of those years were more than 30.000 people forced disappearances.

zh.s: 1976年3月24日，阿根廷右翼政变推翻总统伊莎贝尔·庇隆，由豪尔赫·拉斐尔·魏地拉将军、埃米利奥·爱德华多·马塞拉海军上将和奥兰多·拉蒙·阿戈斯蒂准将领导的军政府接管。军政府将统治正式命名为‘国家重组进程’，持续至1983年12月10日。政变前，军方已在迫害、杀害人员并使人失踪；政变后，政治镇压进一步大规模扩大。这些年里，超过30,000人被强迫失踪。

en.s: The Indian National Congress (INC), also known as the Congress Party, or simply the Congress, is a big tent political party in India. It is India's oldest existing political party and is widely regarded as one of the world's oldest continuously active political parties, outside Europe and North America. Founded on 28 December 1885, it was the first modern nationalist movement to emerge in the British Empire in Asia and Africa.
en.n: Morarji Desai becomes the prime minister of India, the first prime minister not to belong to Indian National Congress.

en.s: The Darlington by-election, 1983 was a parliamentary by-election held on 24 March 1983 for the British House of Commons constituency of Darlington in County Durham. The seat had become vacant when the constituency's Labour Member of Parliament (MP), Edward Fletcher had died on 13 February 1983, a few days before his 72nd birthday. He had held the seat since the 1964 general election. The result of the contest was a victory for the Labour candidate, Oswald O'Brien, who won with a majority of 2,412 over the Conservative Party candidate Michael Fallon.

zh.s: 英国下议院达勒姆郡达灵顿选区于1983年3月24日举行补选。工党议员爱德华·弗莱彻于2月13日、72岁生日数天前去世，留下议席空缺。他自1964年大选起代表该选区。工党候选人奥斯瓦尔德·奥布赖恩以领先2,412票的优势，击败保守党候选人迈克尔·法伦。

en.s: Elections were held in the state of New South Wales, Australia, on Saturday 24 March 1984. The Labor government led by Neville Wran won a fourth term in office, though with a reduced (if still sizeable) majority and a 7% swing against it. As the two previous elections each saw the sitting Opposition Leader lose the election and failing to be elected to Parliament, the 1984 election saw Nick Greiner becoming the first Opposition Leader to lose an election and retain his seat since Pat Hills in 1974. Independents Ted Mack and John Hatton retained their seats of North Shore and South Coast respectively.

zh.s: 澳大利亚新南威尔士州于1984年3月24日星期六举行选举。内维尔·兰领导的工党政府赢得第四个任期，但选票向对手摆动7个百分点，多数席位优势有所缩小，仍相当可观。此前两届选举中，反对党领袖都不仅输掉大选，还失去自身议席。因此，尼克·格雷纳成为自1974年帕特·希尔斯以来，首位败选但保住议席的反对党领袖。独立议员特德·麦克与约翰·哈顿，分别保住北岸和南海岸席位。

en.s: The 1985 Football League Cup final was won by Norwich City. en.t: Action in the Gulf of Sidra (1986)
en.s: In the Action in the Gulf of Sidra, codenamed Operation Prairie Fire, the United States Navy deployed aircraft carrier groups in the disputed Gulf of Sidra in the Mediterranean Sea. Libya had claimed that the entire Gulf was their territory, at 32° 30' N, with an exclusive 62 nautical miles (115 km; 71 mi) fishing zone. Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi asserted this in 1973, and dubbed it "The Line of Death".

zh.s: 1986年3月24日，美国海军在地中海有争议的锡德拉湾部署航母战斗群，开展代号“草原烈火”的行动。利比亚主张北纬32度30分以南的整个海湾属于本国领土，并声称拥有62海里的专属捕鱼区；卡扎菲自1973年起把这条界线称为“死亡线”。

en.s: General elections were held in Gibraltar on 24 March 1988. The elections were a watershed in Gibraltar politics, as they saw the first win by the Gibraltar Socialist Labour Party (GSLP), led by Joe Bossano, whose candidates took 58% of the popular vote and eight of the fifteen seats available in the Gibraltar House of Assembly. Bossano's party took control away from the Association for the Advancement of Civil Rights (AACR), under outgoing Chief Minister Adolfo Canepa. The AACR had been the dominant political party in Gibraltar politics for over forty years and had won every election but one since 1945.

zh.s: 直布罗陀于1988年3月24日举行大选，成为当地政治的分水岭。乔·博萨诺领导的直布罗陀社会主义工党首次获胜，获得58%的选票及议会15席中的8席，取代即将卸任首席部长阿道弗·卡内帕领导的民权促进协会。民权促进协会此前已主导直布罗陀政治四十多年，自1945年以来，除一次外赢得所有选举。

zh.s: 1993年3月24日晚，卡罗琳·舒梅克、尤金·舒梅克和大卫·列维发现舒梅克－列维9号彗星。它曾在1992年7月分裂，随后于1994年7月撞上木星，使人类首次直接观测到太阳系天体在地球以外发生碰撞；这次撞击受到媒体广泛报道，也引来世界各地天文学家的观测。

en.s: The 1996 Uncensored was the second Uncensored professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). The event took place on March 24, 1996, from the Tupelo Coliseum in Tupelo, Mississippi. Seven matches were contested at the pay-per-view. The major attraction of the event was the main event, a Doomsday Cage match pitting Hulk Hogan and Randy Savage against the Alliance to End Hulkamania, a group consisting of Ric Flair, Arn Anderson and The Dungeon of Doom.

en.s: The 1998 Westside Middle School shooting was a mass shooting that occurred on March 24, 1998, at Westside Middle School in unincorporated Craighead County, Arkansas, near the city of Jonesboro. Thirteen-year-old Mitchell Johnson and eleven-year-old Andrew Golden opened fire on the school, shooting and killing five people and wounding ten others. Both were arrested when they attempted to flee the scene.

zh.s: 1998年3月24日，美国阿肯色州琼斯伯勒附近、克雷格黑德县非建制地区的西区中学发生大规模枪击。13岁的米切尔·约翰逊和11岁的安德鲁·戈尔登向学校开枪，杀害5人，另有10人受伤。两人在试图逃离现场时被捕。

en.s: The 1998 Nova Scotia general election was held on March 24, 1998, to elect members of the 57th House of Assembly of the province of Nova Scotia, Canada. The Liberal party and the New Democratic Party tied in the seat count, with 19 each, while the Progressive Conservatives won 14 seats. The Liberals went on to form a minority government with the support of the Progressive Conservatives.

zh.s: 加拿大新斯科舍省于1998年3月24日举行大选，选出第57届省议会议员。自由党与新民主党各获19席，席位数打平；进步保守党获得14席。自由党随后在进步保守党支持下组成少数派政府。

en.s: On 24 March 1999, a transport truck caught fire while driving through the Mont Blanc Tunnel between France and Italy. When it stopped halfway through the tunnel, it violently combusted. Other vehicles in the tunnel quickly became trapped and caught fire as firefighters could not reach the transport truck. 39 people were killed. In the aftermath, major changes were made to the tunnel to improve its safety.

zh.s: 1999年3月24日，一辆货车在法国与意大利之间的勃朗峰隧道内行驶时起火。货车停在隧道中段后猛烈燃烧，其他车辆很快被困并起火，消防员无法接近货车。事故造成39人死亡。此后，隧道进行了重大改造以提高安全性。

en.s: The North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) carried out an aerial bombing campaign against the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia during the Kosovo War. The air strikes lasted from 24 March 1999 to 10 June 1999. The bombings continued until an agreement was reached that led to the withdrawal of the Yugoslav Army from Kosovo, and the establishment of the United Nations Interim Administration Mission in Kosovo, a UN peacekeeping mission in Kosovo.

zh.s: 科索沃战争期间，北大西洋公约组织（北约）对南斯拉夫联盟共和国展开空袭行动。空袭从1999年3月24日持续至6月10日。轰炸一直持续到双方达成协议，促使南斯拉夫军队撤出科索沃，并设立联合国驻科索沃临时行政当局特派团维和任务。

en.s: The Battle of Komsomolskoye took place in Chechnya during the Second Chechen War. Beginning on 6 March 2000 and lasting until 24 March 2000, it resulted in the deaths of more than 50 Russian soldiers and hundreds of Chechen militants over the course of two weeks of siege warfare. An unknown number of civilians were killed in the fighting as well.

en.s: The Kuomintang chairmanship election of 2001 (Chinese: 2001年中國國民黨主席補選) was held on 24 March 2001 in Taiwan. This was the first direct party leadership election in Kuomintang history in which all registered, due-paying party members were eligible to vote. In previous elections, only 2,000 high-ranking members could cast votes.

zh.s: 2001年中国国民党主席选举于3月24日在台湾举行。这是国民党历史上首次直接选举党魁，所有登记并缴纳党费的党员都有资格投票。此前的选举仅允许约2,000名高层党员投票。

en.s: The 2002 Football League Trophy Final (known as the LDV Vans Trophy for sponsorship reasons) was the 19th final of the Football League Trophy – a domestic football cup competition for teams from the Football League Second and Third Division. The match was played at the Millennium Stadium in Cardiff, and was contested by Blackpool and Cambridge United on 24 March 2002. Blackpool won the match 4–1.

zh.s: 2002年英格兰联赛锦标赛决赛因赞助关系也称‘LDV厢式车杯决赛’，是该赛事第19届决赛。这项国内足球杯赛由当时英格兰乙级和丙级联赛球队参加。决赛于2002年3月24日在卡迪夫千禧球场举行，由布莱克浦对阵剑桥联，布莱克浦以4比1获胜。

en.s: The 2003 attack on Karbala was an unsuccessful strike on the Iraqi Republican Guard's Medina Division by the U.S. 3rd Infantry Division during the 2003 invasion of Iraq. The Medina Division was mostly deployed along the Karbala gap, west of the city of Karbala itself. The Iraqi division was targeted as it was the best equipped Iraqi unit, and its destruction would negatively affect Iraqi military morale.

zh.s: 2003年卡尔巴拉袭击是美国第3步兵师在入侵伊拉克期间，对伊拉克共和国卫队麦地那师发动的一次未能奏效的攻击。麦地那师主要部署在卡尔巴拉城以西的卡尔巴拉缺口一带。美军将其列为目标，是因为该师装备最精良；摧毁它会严重打击伊拉克军队的士气。

en.s: The 2007 New South Wales state election was held on Saturday, 24 March 2007. The entire Legislative Assembly and half of the Legislative Council was up for election. The Labor Party led by Morris Iemma won a fourth four-year term against the Liberal–National coalition led by Peter Debnam. Labor's majority survived the election almost intact going from a 13 seat majority prior to the election to a marginally decreased 11 seat majority.

zh.s: 新南威尔士州于2007年3月24日（星期六）举行州选举。立法议会全部席位和立法委员会一半席位进行改选。莫里斯·伊玛领导的工党击败彼得·德布纳姆领导的自由党与国民党联盟，连续第四次赢得四年任期。工党在选举前占有13席多数，选后仅小幅缩减至11席。

en.s: The 2008 Summer Olympics torch relay was run from March 24 until August 8, 2008, prior to the 2008 Summer Olympics, with the theme of "one world, one dream". Plans for the relay were announced on April 26, 2007, in Beijing, China. The relay, also called by the organizers as the "Journey of Harmony", lasted 129 days and carried the torch 137,000 km (85,000 mi) – the longest distance of any Olympic torch relay since the tradition was started ahead of the 1936 Summer Olympics.

zh.s: 2008年夏季奥运会火炬接力于2008年3月24日至8月8日举行，为2008年夏季奥运会预热，主题是“同一个世界，同一个梦想”。接力计划于2007年4月26日在中国北京公布。组织者称这次活动为“和谐之旅”，历时129天，火炬传递里程达13.7万公里（8.5万英里），是自1936年夏季奥运会前开启火炬接力传统以来距离最长的一次。

en.s: An election for the leadership of the New Democratic Party (NDP), a social democratic party in Canada, was called for March 24, 2012, in order to elect a permanent successor to Jack Layton who had died the previous summer. The New Democratic Party's executive and caucus set the rules for the campaign at a series of meetings in September 2011. The election took place in Toronto and on the Internet. At the Leadership Convention, held at the Metro Toronto Convention Centre, Thomas Mulcair was declared to be the new leader of the party.

zh.t: 2012年加拿大新民主党党魁选举
zh.s: 加拿大社会民主主义政党新民主党于2012年3月24日举行党魁选举，为前一年夏天去世的杰克·林顿选出正式继任者。党执行委员会和议会党团在2011年9月的一系列会议中确定竞选规则。投票在多伦多及网上进行。在多伦多都会会议中心举行的党魁大会上，汤马斯·马尔凯被宣布当选。

en.s: The 2012 Louisiana Democratic presidential primary was held on March 24, 2012. President Barack Obama received little opposition in the 2012 Democratic primaries, handily winning overall with over 88% of the vote. However, Tennessee attorney and perennial political candidate John Wolfe Jr. challenged President Obama in the primaries, and received nearly 12% of the vote.

zh.t: 2012年路易斯安那州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2012年路易斯安那州民主党总统初选于3月24日举行。贝拉克·奥巴马总统在该年民主党初选中几乎未遇有力竞争，在此次投票中以超过88%的得票率轻松获胜。田纳西州律师、长期多次参选的约翰·小沃尔夫挑战奥巴马，获得近12%的选票。

en.s: Svenska Supercupen 2012, Swedish Super Cup 2012, was the 6th Svenska Supercupen, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Allsvenskan and Svenska Cupen competitions. The match was played at Olympia, Helsingborg, on 24 March 2012, and was contested by league winners Helsingborgs IF and runners-up AIK. Voting was compulsory for any person who is on the Northern Territory electoral roll in an address that is within a council area. Like the territory's general elections, the local elections were conducted by the Northern Territory Electoral Commission (NTEC).

zh.s: 2012年比利时杯决赛因赞助商而称为科菲迪斯杯，于2012年3月24日由科特赖克对阵洛克伦。这是第57届比利时杯决赛，洛克伦获胜。比赛一开始双方就积极进攻，科特赖克在第一分钟内便获得一次射门机会；洛克伦随后由哈姆迪·哈拉巴维打入一球，但因越位判罚被正确取消。

en.s: The 2012 Queensland state election was held on 24 March 2012 to elect all 89 members of the Legislative Assembly, a unicameral parliament. The Labor Party (ALP), led by Premier Anna Bligh, was defeated by the opposition Liberal National Party (LNP), led by Campbell Newman in a landslide victory. zh.s: 昆士兰州于2012年3月24日举行州选举，改选一院制州立法议会的全部89个席位。安娜·布莱领导的工党被坎贝尔·纽曼领导的反对党自由国家党大败。工党此前自1989年以来连续赢得每次大选，本次试图争取连续第九次胜选，但曾于1996年至1998年间失去执政地位。

en.s: The 2013 FA Trophy Final was the 44th final of the Football Association's cup competition for levels 5–8 of the English football league system. The match was contested between Grimsby Town and Wrexham. It was Wrexham's first visit to Wembley Stadium in their 149-year history. Grimsby Town defeated Buxton, Havant & Waterlooville, Welling United, Luton Town and Dartford en route to the Final.

zh.s: 2013年英格兰足总挑战杯决赛是英格兰足球协会杯赛的第44届决赛，参赛球队来自英格兰联赛第五至第八级别。决赛由格里姆斯比镇对阵雷克瑟姆。这是雷克瑟姆149年队史上首次踏上温布利球场。格里姆斯比镇一路淘汰巴克斯顿、哈文特和滑铁卢维尔、韦林联、卢顿镇和达特福德，闯入决赛。

en.s: The 2013 Lahad Datu standoff, also known as the Lahad Datu incursion or Operation Daulat (Malay: Operasi Daulat), was a military conflict in Lahad Datu, Malaysia. The conflict began on 11 February, when 235 militants arrived in Lahad Datu by boat, and ended on 24 March. The militants, self proclaimed as "Royal Security Forces of the Sultanate of Sulu and North Borneo", were sent by Jamalul Kiram III, a claimant to the throne of the Sultanate of Sulu.

zh.s: 2013年拉哈达图对峙又称拉哈达图入侵或“达乌拉特行动”，是马来西亚拉哈达图发生的一场军事冲突。冲突于2月11日开始，当天有235名武装分子乘船抵达拉哈达图，并于3月24日结束。武装分子自称“苏禄苏丹国和北婆罗洲皇家安全部队”，由苏禄苏丹国王位声索者贾马鲁尔·基拉姆三世派遣。

en.s: Germanwings Flight 9525 was a scheduled international passenger flight from Barcelona–El Prat Airport in Spain to Düsseldorf Airport in Germany. The flight was operated by Germanwings, a low-cost carrier owned by the German airline Lufthansa. On 24 March 2015, the Airbus A320 operating the flight crashed 100 km (62 mi; 54 nmi) north-west of Nice in the French Alps, killing all 150 people on board.

zh.s: 德国之翼9525号航班是从西班牙巴塞罗那埃尔普拉特机场飞往德国杜塞尔多夫机场的定期国际客运航班，由汉莎航空旗下廉价航空公司德国之翼运营。2015年3月24日，执飞的空客A320客机在法国阿尔卑斯山区、尼斯西北100公里（62英里、54海里）处坠毁，机上150人全部遇难。

en.s: The 2015 Jacksonville mayoral election took place on March 24, 2015, to elect the Mayor of Jacksonville, Florida. The election is a blanket primary, with all candidates from all parties running together on the same ballot. As no candidate received a majority of the vote, a runoff was held between the top two vote-getters on May 19, 2015.

zh.s: 佛罗里达州杰克逊维尔于2015年3月24日举行市长选举。初选采用不分党派的制度，所有政党的候选人都列在同一张选票上。由于无人获得过半选票，得票最高的两名候选人于2015年5月19日进入决选。

en.s: Two referendums were held by the New Zealand Government in November/December 2015 and March 2016 to determine the nation's flag. In the first referendum, voters chose their favourite alternative flag design. The winning design then advanced to the second referendum, where it went up against the existing flag of New Zealand. The voting resulted in the retention of the existing flag.

en.s: The election of the President of the Chamber of Deputies who would serve through the legislature XVIII of Italy took place on 23 and 24 March 2018, weeks after the 2022 Italian general election. Roberto Fico was elected on the fourth ballot following an agreement between the Five Star Movement and the centre-right coalition.

en.s: The 2018 Scottish Challenge Cup final, also known as the IRN-BRU Cup final for sponsorship reasons, was a football match that took place on 24 March 2018 at McDiarmid Park, between Dumbarton and Inverness Caledonian Thistle. It was the 27th final of the Scottish Challenge Cup since it was first organised in 1990 to celebrate the centenary of the now defunct Scottish Football League, and the fifth since the SPFL was formed.

zh.s: 2018年苏格兰挑战杯决赛因赞助商而称为IRN-BRU杯决赛，于2018年3月24日在麦克迪阿米德公园球场举行，由邓巴顿对阵因弗内斯喀里多尼亚蓟队。这是苏格兰挑战杯第27届决赛。赛事于1990年创办，以庆祝已解散的苏格兰足球联赛成立百年；这是苏格兰职业足球联赛成立后的第五届决赛。

en.t: 2018 President of the Italian Senate election
en.s: The election for the President of the Senate of the Republic who would serve through the legislature XVIII of Italy took place on 23 and 24 March 2018, over three weeks after the 2018 Italian general election. It took place by secret ballot, as required by the assembly's standing orders. Former President of Italy Giorgio Napolitano, being the oldest Senator present, served as the acting presiding officer.

zh.s: 意大利第十八届议会参议院议长选举于2018年3月23日至24日举行，距离2018年意大利大选已有三个多星期。根据议会常规，选举采用无记名投票。当时在场的资深参议员、意大利前总统乔治·纳波利塔诺担任临时主持人。

en.s: General elections were held in Thailand on 24 March 2019. They were the first elections since the 2014 Thai coup d'état that installed coup leader General Prayut Chan-o-cha as prime minister, and the first held in accordance with the 2017 constitution, which was drafted under the ruling military junta. The elections selected the five hundred members of the new House of Representatives, the previous House having been dissolved by the coup.

zh.s: 泰国于2019年3月24日举行大选，这是2014年政变后首次选举。该次政变使领导者巴育·占奥差将军出任总理。此次也是军政府主导制定的2017年宪法生效后的首次选举，选出新众议院500名议员，上一届众议院已在政变中被解散。

en.s: Early presidential elections were held in the Comoros on 24 March 2019 alongside regional elections. A second round would have been held on 21 April if required, but incumbent President Azali Assoumani was re-elected in the first round of voting.

en.s: The 2019 Zürich cantonal elections were held on 24 March 2019, to elect the seven members of the cantonal Executive Council and the 180 members of the Cantonal Council. All five incumbents running were re-elected to the Executive Council, as well as green candidate Martin Neukom and Swiss People's Party candidate Natalie Rickli. The election was an upset for the left-wing and green parties.

en.s: The 2019 Basilicata regional election took place on 24 March 2019. The election was for all 21 seats of the Regional Council of Basilicata and the president of Basilicata, who automatically became a member of the council alongside the second-placed candidate. This election was the last one in Italy before the 2019 European Parliament election and the third one of the 2019 Italian regional elections.

zh.s: 巴西利卡塔大区于2019年3月24日举行选举，改选大区委员会全部21个席位并选出大区主席。主席自动成为委员会成员，得票第二的候选人也将成为委员会成员。这是2019年欧洲议会选举前意大利举行的最后一场地方选举，也是该年度第三场意大利大区选举。

en.s: The 2023 Sacrifice was a professional wrestling event produced by Impact Wrestling. The event took place on March 24, 2023, at St. Clair College in Windsor, Ontario, Canada, and aired on Impact Plus and YouTube. It was the 14th event under the Sacrifice chronology, and Impact's first televised event in Canada since 2019. The event also featured wrestlers from partner promotion New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW).

en.s: On the evening of Friday, March 24, 2023, a large, violent, and long-tracked multi-vortex wedge tornado struck the Mississippi towns of Rolling Fork, Silver City, and Midnight. The tornado, known most simply as the Rolling Fork tornado or informally the Rolling Fork-Silver City Tornado by the National Weather Service (NWS), killed 17 people and injured at least 165 others.

zh.s: 2023年3月24日星期五傍晚，一场规模大、破坏力强、路径漫长的多涡旋楔形龙卷风袭击了密西西比州的罗林福克、银城和午夜镇。美国国家气象局称其为罗林福克龙卷风，非正式名称为罗林福克—银城龙卷风。龙卷风造成17人死亡、至少165人受伤。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Senegal on 24 March 2024. Incumbent president Macky Sall was ineligible to pursue a third term due to term limits in the Constitution of Senegal. The elections were originally scheduled for 25 February, but were postponed indefinitely by a decree of Sall on 3 February, and then delayed by the National Assembly to 15 December. However, on 15 February the Senegalese Constitutional Council overturned the postponement and ordered elections to proceed as soon as possible, with the government subsequently setting a new election date for 24 March after a national dialogue at the end of February was ruled unconstitutional.

zh.s: 塞内加尔于2024年3月24日举行总统选举。现任总统马基·萨勒受到宪法任期限制，不能争取第三个任期。选举原定2月25日举行，但萨勒于2月3日下令无限期推迟，国民议会随后改定为12月15日。2月15日，宪法委员会推翻延期决定，要求尽快举行选举。2月底全国对话的安排被裁定违宪后，政府最终将新投票日定为3月24日。

Rangers and Partick Thistle were the finalists; the match was televised live in the United Kingdom on Sky Sports and Sky Sports Mix channels.

en.s: The 2024 Scottish Challenge Cup final, also known as the SPFL Trust Trophy final for sponsorship reasons, was a football match on 24 March 2024 between the Cymru Premier club The New Saints and the Scottish Championship side Airdrieonians. It was the 31st final of the Scottish Challenge Cup since it was first organised in 1990 to celebrate the centenary of the now defunct Scottish Football League, and the ninth since the SPFL was formed.

en.s: The 2024 CONCACAF Nations League final was a soccer match to determine the winner of the 2023–24 CONCACAF Nations League. The match was the third final of the CONCACAF Nations League, an international tournament contested by the men's national teams representing the member associations of CONCACAF, which covers North America, Central America, and the Caribbean. The United States defeated Mexico 2–0 to claim the title for the third straight time.

zh.t: 2024年中北美洲及加勒比海国家联赛决赛
zh.s: 2024年中北美洲及加勒比海国家联赛决赛决定2023—24赛季冠军归属，是该项国际赛事的第三届决赛。赛事由代表中北美洲及加勒比海足球协会成员的男子国家队参加。美国队以2比0击败墨西哥队，连续第三次夺得冠军。
